prerequisites.spellbook: Normal spellbook Fire Bolt or higher; helper declares SpellbookRequirement.

route: Martin Holt / Fullore, council-house receipt, cabin boy and Judge of Yama
Forthos, icy settlement and Legless Faun clues

resource_assumptions: The optional trade-enabled supply bundle budgets 95,000 coins for an axe, pickaxe, chisel, Defence(4), volcanic sulphur, molten glass and one Fire Bolt's runes; GE prices are estimates, not observed quotes.
One Fire Bolt (35 Magic, 3 Air + 4 Fire + 1 Chaos) melts the ice; other fire spells and staves are valid but omitted alternatives.
Dark essence is mined at the Arceuus dense essence mine (12 Mining and 8 Crafting XP), then taken to the Dark Altar; the side trip duration is estimated and anchored near Mori for replay.
Completion is separate from the claim of the book and two retained lamps. Older accounts that claimed the Architectural Alliance lamp before 10 January 2024 may receive only one.
The five house assignments can be done in other orders. This catalog records one valid ordered traversal and tracks five distinct completion flags.
